title: ci(test-ui): the live-tree "imported path walker" case in select-affected-tests timed out again (15.8 s of 15 s) on a slow PR runner, after the #31941 shared-memo fix
body:
repo:objectstack#1 · os-elon-musk · session_016WV4cwGVgec21LwQTtRY85

Filing gate: ① reproducible defect in a gate (a deterministic-tree test that times out on a slow runner). Source: fleet.
Grading: area:devpath · Bug · priority:p2 · reach: CI red on a PR run, measured once (below); suggested p2 because the failed-job rerun went green and no merge-queue kick is recorded yet; #31941 (closed) was p1 when it kicked the queue. Triage, please confirm.
Dedupe: issue search `"select-affected-tests" timeout` open: 0; `"select-affected-tests" flake` all states: 5, all closed (#31518 #26460 #25924 #31519 #27055); closest is closed #31941 (same test, same symptom), cited here rather than reopened because its fix landed and this is a fresh reading.

## Reading

- PR #37825 (docs-only: one ADR prose file under `ui/docs/adr/**`), head 8735dfe10fef4a124c1226588462b1761798b32e, CI run 45945413506, job "Test UI (1/16)" (check run 140329796350): `ui/scripts/__tests__/select-affected-tests.test.ts`, case "select-affected-tests — the live tree > a change to the imported path walker selects what a change to the selector itself does (objectstack#31520)", `Error: Test timed out in 15000ms`, the case reporting 15789 ms. 1 failed of 71 in the file; 12437 other tests in the shard passed. The shard log shows a starved runner (transform 135 s, import 1067 s, shard 802 s).
- The failed-job rerun (attempt 2, job 140335443034) passed on the same head.
- The test's own comment (around line 655) says the #31941 shared scan memo brought the three live-tree cases to 4.2 s; this run took 15.8 s for one, so the margin does not hold on a slow runner.
- The diff of that PR cannot reach the test: it changes no code and the test reads no `docs/adr` path.

## Ask

Make the case fit its budget with margin on a slow runner (for example a smaller live-tree fixture, or a per-case timeout that the deterministic work justifies, measured), without weakening what it asserts. Acceptance: the case's own time on PR CI is read from three runs and recorded in the PR.
